prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement through a dimly lit cave, the camera capturing the rough textures of the rocky walls and scattered debris underfoot. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle gradually shifts upward, revealing a narrow opening that leads to an outdoor scene. Emerging from the cave, the camera pans across a rugged coastline illuminated by the faint light of a cloudy night sky. The path ahead is uneven, strewn with rocks and patches of grass, leading along the edge of a cliff where the ocean waves crash against the shore. The camera continues forward, following a dirt trail bordered by a wooden fence on one side and dense foliage on the other. The surrounding trees and shrubs are shrouded in mist, creating a hazy atmosphere that obscures distant details. The camera maintains a consistent eye-level view, capturing the subtle interplay of shadows cast by the sparse moonlight filtering through the clouds. As the journey continues, the path curves gently, revealing more of the serene yet desolate landscape, devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude and quietude of Shengshan Island at night.
